title: 采购入库衔接来源订单并防止累计超收
description: Stage3 priority explicitly authorized 2026-10-08. Complete operational order-to-inventory linkage using existing layered architecture and existing document workflow; no report or Agent work. First deliver core usable partial/full stock workflow; postpone visual/style/export polish.
acceptance_criteria: Use existing StockIn create/update/approve flow and explicit PurchaseOrderId; when linked validate live approved PurchaseOrder, compatible customer/supplier, product identity and basic/package units without guessing ambiguous duplicate order lines. Preserve historical unlinked documents; fail closed on invalid new explicit links. Keep current menu and salesperson/customer scope; no permission expansion.

At approval enforce cumulative active approved StockIn quantities plus this document never exceed linked order authorized quantities by compatible product/unit. Partial batches allowed; canceled/reversed documents release remaining capacity; no cross-unit or currency totals. Serialize same-order concurrent approvals in existing relational transaction so concurrent documents cannot overrun; failed validation leaves stock, movements and status unchanged. Do not rewrite order original quantity, legacy history or add new schema.

Integrate useful conflict messages in existing API and preserve audit/current-user trace through existing workflow. Verify partial/full, repeated approval, cancellation, invalid/missing/foreign source, packaging, duplicate source lines, concurrent overrun and permission denial using meaningful units and guarded NEWERP_AUTOTEST SQL tests; run safe Release build/unit and retain real environment limitations.
implementation_evidence: src/ERP.Api/Controllers/StockInController.cs Approve normalizes units and writes inventory but uses PurchaseOrderId only as remark/cost source; no authoritative cumulative source order quantity guard. Existing ERP025 ledger and ERP033 costs are completed and must be reused. Reviewed ALL task definitions and existing quantity/status/source history.
